text: 17-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing increasing pain and swelling in his right knee for the past 12 days. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (formerly Reiter's syndrome) secondary to a likely untreated urethral infection.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, HLA-B27, Rheumatoid Factor, ESR, CRP, and Syphilis Serology.
REQUEST IMAGES: Knee X-ray and Ankle X-ray to assess for erosive changes or chondrocalcinosis.
